items.t: Where Could Johnson & Johnson's Next Growth Come From?
items.d: Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) stock trades at 29.1 times its earnings over the past twelve months, compared with 22.7 for the S&P 500. Investors paying that premium appear to be counting on more growth.…

items.t: Johnson & Johnson CFO taps internal investment for medtech growth
items.d: The pharma company is on track to reach $100 billion in recorded revenue despite “temporary” headwinds in its medtech segment, executives said.

items.t: Why Did J&J Stock Fall After Q3 Earnings Despite Raised Guidance?
items.d: J&J's shares fell 5.8% despite an earnings beat and raised guidance, as MedTech weakness, drug sales shortfalls and acquisition costs weighed on results.
